sources.title: Microduck - A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI ...
sources.snippet: Microduck - A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI experimentation and fun Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face have unveiled the Microduck, a 25 cm tall biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, a depth sensor, two motion sensors, and an articulated beak that can pick up objects.

sources.title: Nvidia Teaches a $399 Duck Robot to Walk Using AI - TechRepublic
sources.snippet: Nvidia and Hugging Face show how the $399 Microduck robot learns to walk using AI simulation. Explore its hardware, training process, and availability.

sources.title: Using AI Agents to Teach Robots Like Microduck to Walk in Simulation
sources.snippet: The course needs to test both movement and perception. Microduck must learn to move around obstacles and through constrained spaces while maintaining balance. Use these requirements to guide the proposed layout and the objects needed to construct it. A local image-generation model produces a concept image of the course.
